pose: Full side profile of a sturdy Ankylosaurus with a cheeky grin. Heavily armored back and tail club held in a straight horizontal line parallel to the ground. Rendered as a mid-ground character to ensure 34% empty sky above the armor and 34% empty ground below the feet. All four feet must be clearly visible on the desert floor.

framing_presets.WIDE_WEIGHT_STRIP_V2: Extreme wide shot. Small character silhouette centered vertically. Distant desert mountains and a clear blue sky to match the Stegosaurus v5 environment.
